valley_vendor: Marta. Old Marta, they say, and I have earned it. I keep the supply stall for the Valley of Trials: potions, food and drink, thread and flux for your first trade. New recruits always need more than the valley gives them, so buy before you take the road north.
razorhill_vendor: Kelm, merchant of Razor Hill. Potions, food, and the supplies a crafter starts with. This is the last proper stall before Orgrimmar, and prices only go up past the gate.
durotar_vendor: Gruk. I supply the patrols out here in Durotar, a long way from the city. Potions, rations and the basics. If you forgot something in Razor Hill, I probably have it.
southern_durotar_trader: Grima Saltbrand. This is a small trade post on the Durotar road - smelted bars, vials, food for the walk. Take what you need. The next stall is a long way off in either direction.
echoisle_vendor: Shu. The Darkspear call me the Sage, which is kind of dem. I trade at de Landing on de Echo Isles. De islands give us fish and fruit, but potions and thread must be bought, and I am where you buy dem.
zeppelin_master: Snurk, zeppelin master. This is the tower outside Orgrimmar, and the airship from here goes to Tirisfal and to Grom'gol. Long flights, short supplies - I sell potions, bags and food for the crossing. Stock up before you board.
org_scout: Windrider. I scout for the Hold, and I sell what a scout carries: light potions and a few rings that came back off the road. Light, fast, prepared. Anything heavier, try the quartermaster.
org_beast_vendor: Trask Beastcaller. I keep the beast stores in the north-east of Orgrimmar, by the hunters. Feed, meat, and what a handler needs to keep an animal fighting. The beasts of Durotar are fed and cared for here before they are sent anywhere.
org_reagent_vendor: Ulvara Deepwind. I sell reagents below the Hold - vials, powders, and potions for every school of magic. Mage, shaman or warlock, I do not play favourites. I only ask that you pay.
org_engineer: Snizzle Boltcrank, engineering supplies, north side of Orgrimmar. Flux, bars, bolts and bags. Good machines start with good materials, and bad machines start with whatever the last customer bought somewhere else.
orgrimmar_quartermaster: Quartermaster Grosh. I supply the Warchief's troops from the west side of the city: rations, potions, flux and bars for the forge. The Horde marches on full bellies and sharp steel, and both come through me.
orgrimmar_provisioner: Grukk Ironhide, provisioner. My stall is on the west side of Orgrimmar. Spices, cooking stock, bags, and potions if you must. This city eats well, and I am the reason.
orgrimmar_elixir_trader: Zeeka Bloodfang. Elixirs and potions, already brewed, on the west side of the city. I do the brewing so you do not have to buy the vials and ruin the batch yourself.
org_demonic_vendor: Karnessa Voidsight. I sell to the warlocks on the east side of Orgrimmar - vials, reagents and potions for those who summon. The Warchief permits the trade so long as I ask no questions and answer every one of his.
deathknell_undertaker: Mordo, undertaker of Deathknell. I also keep the only shop here: potions, thread, vials, sacks. The newly risen need supplies like any living thing does. Mostly.
brill_reagent_dealer: Silas Grimme, reagents. My shop is on the north side of Brill. Vials, powders and potions, for the mages and warlocks the Undercity sends up here to practise. They keep me busy and I do not ask what for.
brill_innkeeper: Renee. This is the Gallows' End, Brill's tavern. Food, drink and a bed, and a hearth you can call home. Rest your feet. Tirisfal is hard walking and it does not get easier toward the Bulwark.
brill_tailor: Vance, seamstress, on the west side of Brill. Thread, dye, patterns, and cut wood for the frames. I sell what goes into a garment and the knowledge to make it. What you sew with them is your business.
brill_general_goods: Fennimore, general goods, on the east side of town. Thread, flux, vials, lures, bread - a little of everything a crafter or a hunter runs out of. That is Brill for you: one of each thing and a queue for it.
brill_butcher: Hollane, butcher of Brill. Cuts, cured meat, flour and salt for the cook, and leather off whatever I have dressed. Most of my customers no longer eat. The living who pass through make up for them.
uc_demonic_vendor: Zalnak, imp-keeper. I sell to the warlocks of the Magic Quarter: vials, reagents, and potions for summoners. We do not discuss where any of it comes from, and the Dreadmaster prefers it that way.
uc_quartermaster: Quartermaster Dolan. I supply the Dark Lady's Deathguard from the west side of the Undercity. Flux, vials, rations for the living, and potions. Her forces demand the best, and I am held to account when they do not get it.
uc_arcane_vendor: Arcanist Welsh. My shop is on the east edge of the city, by the enchantress. Vials, reagents and potions for anyone who works with the arcane. The Undercity breeds scholars and every one of them is short of something.
uc_provisioner: Nell, provisioner, west side of the Undercity. Thread, leather, lures, flour, bread. Provisioning the dead is still provisioning - they wear out boots and bags as fast as anyone.
uc_poison_vendor: Sable. I sell poisons and the vials for them in the War Quarter, near the rogues. The Deathstalkers buy from me. So can you, if you can tell me which end of a blade is which.
uc_innkeeper: Nethra. This is the Undercity's inn, at the south-east of the market by the bat roost. Food, drink, and a hearth to bind to. The city does not sleep, so neither do I, but the living are welcome to.
uc_elixir_trader: Quill, elixir dealer, in the Apothecarium. Elixirs and potions, tested, labelled and safe - which is more than can be said for anything else brewed in this quarter. Every soldier needs an edge.
uc_reagent_vendor: Hollis, reagent dealer, at the south end of the city. The craft guilds send me their lists: thread, bars, powders, whatever the benches have run out of. If you make things, you will end up here.
undercity_zeppelin_master: Grub, zeppelin master. This tower is above the ruins of Lordaeron, and the airship from here goes to Orgrimmar and to Grom'gol. I sell potions, bags and food for the flight. The zeppelin waits for no one.
crossroads_general_goods: Vrakk Thundertusk, general goods at the Crossroads. Thread, flux, vials, lures, flour. If you make things, I sell what goes into them. Every caravan that stops here empties my shelves and fills them again.
crossroads_stablemaster: Grosh, stablemaster. The stables are on the west side of the Crossroads. I sell feed and travelling food, and I will keep your mount while you are out. The animals here eat well. You should too.
crossroads_provisioner: Tarhek, provisioner. My store is on the east side of the Crossroads. Food, potions, thread, bags - everything a traveller needs before the Barrens, under one roof. It is three days to the next one.
crossroads_weaponsmith: Kagra Ironbind, weaponsmith. I work by the forge on the west side of town. Flux, bars and whetstones, and potions for when the weapon was not enough. Good steel needs good flux, and I sell both.
crossroads_alchemist: Mishka Emberflask, alchemist. East side of the Crossroads. I sell vials for those who brew, and potions and elixirs for those who cannot yet. Come back when you can make your own and I will sell you the vials instead.
crossroads_fletcher: Fizzwick Trueshot, fletcher, by the south-west wall. Bowstring, feathers, resin, arrows - everything that turns a plank into a bow and keeps it shooting. I also have a ring or two the scouts traded in.
ratchet_explosives_dealer: Fuzzek Boomwick. Explosives, flux and elixirs, on the north side of Ratchet. It is all the same business, really - things in bottles that change your afternoon. Do not shake anything.
ratchet_black_market_fence: They call me the Fence. I stand at the west edge of Ratchet and I sell what the port did not see come in. What you are looking for is not on anybody's shelf. That is why you came to me.
ratchet_dockmaster: Brindle, dockmaster of Ratchet. The pier is behind me and the boat to Booty Bay leaves from it. I sell rations, spice and bags to crews, and I drink the rest of my wages.
ratchet_shipping_trader: Blix, cargo master. I work the middle of the dockside. Thread, flux, vials, food - I ship in what the Barrens cannot make, and I sell what the ships leave behind.
ratchet_tavern_keeper: Molka. This is Ratchet's tavern, west of the docks. Sit down. I will get you something. I have food, spice for your own cooking, and a few things customers left to settle their bills.
ratchet_trader: Nixx. Yes, Gazlowe's cousin - everyone in Ratchet is. I trade at the south end of town: thread, flux, vials, food. Ratchet moves goods between the Horde and everybody else, and I take a small piece of all of it.
taurajo_quartermaster: Hela Windhoof, quartermaster of Camp Taurajo. Since Thunder Bluff fell, every tribe sends its people here and I have to feed them. Potions, food, thread, flux. The camp runs lean, so what you see is what we have.
taurajo_hide_trader: Trader Bloodhorn. My racks are on the west side of the camp. Hides come in from the plains and leather goes out to the tribes. I sell bars, salts and the tools for the work in between.
taurajo_beast_trainer: Nira, beastcaller. I keep the kodo and the hunting beasts on the east side of Camp Taurajo. I sell feed, lures, flour and salt, and a few bows. Beasts and their keepers both need looking after.
taurajo_totem_crafter: Dennok, spiritcarver. I work on the west side of the camp. Totem wood, vials, arrows, staves and bows. The spirits need preparing for, and so does anyone going south of here.
taurajo_provisioner: Yura, grainkeeper. The cook-fire at the south end of Camp Taurajo is mine. Bread, spice, bags of grain. The plains give us the meat and I do the rest.
nb_basecamp_vendor: Quartermaster Gruzk Ironhide. This is the Horde base camp in the Northern Barrens, and I supply it. Potions, rations, flux, bars. We move when the front moves, so take what you need now.
sb_waystation_vendor: Hemma Redbrand, provisioner. This is the waystation on the Southern Barrens road. Potions, food, thread and flux - only what fits in a saddle bag, because that is how it gets here.
sepulcher_reagent_seller: Wrenn, apothecary to the Sepulcher. My bench is in the middle of the keep. Vials, reagents, potions and elixirs. I am also short of wasp stings, if you are going out toward the orchard.
sepulcher_mortician_supplier: Grieve, mortician. I work on the west side of the Lower Court. Salt, leather, bars, and potions for the garrison. Preservation is an art, and in a keep full of Forsaken it is also steady work.
sepulcher_innkeeper: Doss. This is the Sepulcher's inn, in the Lower Court just inside the gate. Food, drink, a bed and a hearth. The keep is cold. My fire is not.
sepulcher_relic_dealer: Fenn, curio merchant, on the east side of the Lower Court. I sell what comes up out of the crypts once the Commander has looked at it, and potions to pay the rent. Old things, new uses.
sp_rg_quartermaster: Quartermaster Brask, Forsaken Rear Guard. This is the north gate of Silverpine. I sell potions, rations, thread and flux to anyone going down the Trunk Road. The forest is dangerous. Buy before you go in, not after.
sp_south_quartermaster: Quartermaster Vorn. I supply the March here at Valgan's Field, in the south of Silverpine. Potions, rations, thread, flux. There are worgen between this post and everywhere else, so stock up.
fenris_provisioner: Dunn, provisioner of Bloodmoon Village. Vials, leather, lures, flour, some mail. Fenris Isle gets one boat when the ferryman feels brave, so what is on this table is all there is.
astranaar_weaponsmith: I am the Sentinels' weaponsmith, on the west side of Astranaar. Arrows, whetstones, and potions. It is Sentinel issue: maintained and sharp. Look after what you buy here.
astranaar_provisioner: Shaldrissa, provisioner. My stores are by the inn on the east side of Astranaar. Food, water, bags, and potions for the pain. In that order, usually.
astranaar_outfitter: I outfit the Sentinels, on the west side of Astranaar. Thread, flux, vials and bars for those who make their own gear. Everything here is meant for someone who has to move through a forest in it.
splintertree_quartermaster_shop: Quartermaster Huln, Splintertree Post. My store is on the east side, near the inn. Arrows, rations, potions. The Overseer signs for it, you carry it, and I would like it back in one piece.
splintertree_supplier: Vokk, supplier. East side of the post. Rope, thread, flux, vials, bars. None of it is glamorous, and you will be back for all of it.
splintertree_provisioner: Grishna, cook. The mess is at the south-east of Splintertree, by the inn. Bread, hot meals, bags. Eat before you go out. I am not sending anybody into that forest hungry.
zoram_fishmonger: Sylra, fishmonger of Zoram Strand. I sell fish and bread, and whatever else comes to a post this remote - a bow, a robe, a few bars. Some of it I haul in. Some of it washes up.
ashenvale_satyr_fence: Veln Ashgrease. I trade on the edge of the Demon Wastes, where neither the Horde nor the Sentinels come looking. Arrows, elixirs, rings that had other owners. You did not see me. Now - what do you need?
tarren_mill_bowyer: Tess Aldren, bowyer. My bench is on the west bank of Tarren Mill, the village side. Bows, staves and cut wood. The yew comes from the stand by the river, and I string it the way my father did.
tarren_mill_reagent_seller: Factor Vell. I keep the Royal Apothecary Society's ledger in Tarren Mill and sell from its stores: vials, bars, bags, food. The Society requisitions and I write it down, which keeps everyone honest.
tarren_mill_vat_tender: Grusk, vat-tender, in the Apothecarium on the east bank. Reagents and elixirs, fresh from the vats. Stir it, skim it, log it. Twelve years dead, and I have a trade again.
tarren_mill_trader: Serrin Holt. I keep the village shop on the west bank. Flour, thread, lamp oil, vials. Whatever the mill does not use, I sell, to the living and the dead alike.
tarren_mill_smith: Odrin Vance, smith, on the west bank by Mill Row. Flux, mail, and repairs. I shoe the Forsaken's horses and mend their cart axles now. A trade is a trade.
tarren_mill_apothecary: Lysbet Crane, apothecary. This is the Apothecarium, the east bank of Tarren Mill. I sell potions and elixirs. Mind the vats behind me - what is in them is not finished.
tarren_mill_innkeeper: Mallory Dunn. This is the inn at Tarren Mill, at the south end of the village bank. A room, a meal and a hearth. I will not ask which side of the race you came from.
hbw_southpoint_quartermaster: Quartermaster Dreng, Southpoint Tower. These are the tower's stores: potions, rations, vials, bars. Everything is signed for and counted, so pay for what you take.
hbw_fields_quartermaster: Quartermaster Ivek. This is the Forsaken forward post on the edge of the Hillsbrad Fields. Rations, thread, flux, bars. A forward post gets plain stock - if you want anything fine, go back to Southpoint.
hbe_mill_quartermaster: Quartermaster Sule. I keep the gate stores outside Tarren Mill. Rations, flux, spice, a few rings. The town has its own shops across the bridges. This table is for people who are leaving.
